title: Public Talks & Engagement
text:
I am passionate about sharing my knowledge of the Thames Estuary and its remarkable wildlife with wider audiences.
I offer accessible and engaging public talks exploring the ecology, biodiversity, environmental history and conservation of the Thames Estuary.

title: Public Talks & Engagement
text:
Talk topics

The Hidden World of the Thames
Fishes of the Thames Estuary
From Pollution to Recovery
Restoring the Thames
Discovering Biodiversity Through DNA

I welcome invitations from local societies, community groups, museums, educational institutions, environmental organisations and public event organisers.
Talks can be tailored to different audiences and delivered in person or online.

title: Wanda Bodnar
text:
I am a Chartered Marine Scientist and researcher with a particular interest in estuarine ecology, fish biodiversity, habitat restoration and conservation.
My research focuses on the Thames Estuary and the ecological importance of intertidal habitats in supporting fish communities.

title: Wanda Bodnar
text:
I am a Chartered Marine Scientist and researcher with a particular interest in estuarine ecology, fish biodiversity, habitat restoration and conservation.
My research focuses on the Thames Estuary and the ecological importance of intertidal habitats in supporting fish communities.

title: Wanda Bodnar
text:
Research interests

Estuarine and coastal ecology
Fish biodiversity and assemblage dynamics
Habitat restoration and conservation
Environmental DNA (eDNA)
Habitat connectivity
Science communication and public engagement

title: Research
text:
My research investigates the ecological importance of intertidal habitats for fish communities in the Thames Estuary.
The research combines long-term ecological monitoring, environmental DNA, fish ecology and habitat assessments to inform evidence-based restoration and conservation.
